name: Whitfield
gaps: Parcels are Parcels_and_Development Parcels (official Whitfield GIS) (https://gis.whitfieldcountyga.com/server/rest/services/Parcels_and_Development/MapServer/4). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Household income stays the ACS B19013_001E tract join. GDOT AADT is not copied onto the parcel.
Pass 2 sale attributes were joined from Recent Sales (saleyear only — no price) onto 1953 parcels.
Source query returned 7074 rows; 5023 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 tax is REST, sale is REST-partial, and owner is REST. HTML-only values were not scraped.
Property-appraiser links use each parcel id in the pass-2 template and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
